description:
Every marketing snapshot for a property: asking price over time, price
    reductions, days listed, status changes, agent, image count and whether it
    had a floor plan.

    `price_trajectory` appears only when at least two snapshots carry a price.
    No listing at all is a real answer, not a failure — a property sold
    off-market or never advertised has none.

    UK only. Costs 15 credits (15p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: listing_history
title: Listing history for a property
